##### Project general facts

Evelyn on the Park by Nshama Group is a beautifully designed residential project that reflects modern living at its best. The development offers a refined collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to suit different lifestyles and family needs. With contemporary architecture, open layouts, and generous windows, the project creates homes that feel bright, calm, and welcoming.

The project features a wide range of amenities that truly enhance everyday life and comfort. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, children’s play areas, BBQ spaces, a pet wash, and direct access to West Park, all designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle. Every amenity is carefully integrated to create a relaxed, community-focused environment that feels both lively and peaceful.

Inside the apartments, the interiors are elegant, functional, and finished to a high standard. Open-plan layouts, soft natural light, and refined materials create a sense of space and understated luxury throughout each home. Fully fitted and well-crafted kitchens with branded appliances offering a timeless look that combines comfort, quality, and everyday ease.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
